name: skeleton-sunburn
comment: WP-2.3b. Stone platform y = 60 over -8..8 with a one-high rim; noon (set_time 6000; the skeleton joins at t=1), no player, difficulty 1. EntitySkeleton.onLivingUpdate's daylight burn (isDaytime, brightness > 0.5, canBlockSeeTheSky, then rand.nextFloat() * 30 < (brightness - 0.4) * 2 sets fire 300), Entity's fire damage every 20 ticks through EntityMob.attackEntityFrom (no attacker: Math.random attackedAtYaw), the EntityCreature wander (EntityMob.getBlockPathWeight, all cells equally bright), death and EntitySkeleton.dropFewItems (rand.nextInt(3) arrows, rand.nextInt(3) bones). rng_state and entity_state every tick.
